Source contracts: scripts/install-website.py

scripts/install-website.py

Python · Tier B

Install, back up and restore the standalone Docker Compose website on Linux.

Usage

Run via install-website.sh on the website host with Python 3 and Docker Compose.

Inputs

--data-dir selects private persistent state; --project selects Compose ownership. Defaults are unattended; --interactive enables settings and administrator prompts. Backup, confirmed restore and administrator recovery flags select maintenance actions.

Side effects

Builds the local checkout, manages containers, writes configuration/secrets and backups, migrates the CMS database and publishes its content snapshot.

Cleanup

Holds a nonblocking installation lock for the invocation; failed migrations leave website writes stopped for explicit recovery. No controller or Gateway is launched.

@see install-website.sh

@see docs/website-cms.md
